sessions.work: #110: the renewed #80 pilot (/private/tmp/ev/pilot) paused when pilot-falinks failed as infrastructure_failure. Bash kept its cwd at scratch/w across a turn boundary, and the adapter required every init cwd to equal scratch exactly. Repair: an init cwd, with symlinks resolved, may be scratch or beneath it; anything outside still fails closed. No frozen material changed. The pilot reruns in a fresh /private/tmp/ev/pilot2.

sessions.measurement: Two timed segments, excluding the user pause between them: the pilot2 batch invocation 09:34:39-09:47:45Z (verify, gate, both runs, cleanup; 786 s); evidence review and repair 11:02:56-11:16:20Z (transcript review, issue, fix, final CI; 804 s). sessions.work: #112: the #80 pilot rerun (/private/tmp/ev/pilot2) passed both arms, but its transcripts showed unequal agent environments. The Git-arm worker sets GOCACHE in scratch, GOTOOLCHAIN=local and GOPROXY=off; the Falinks-arm launch set none, so an agent's first go test failed on Go's sandbox-denied default cache. Repair: the Falinks-arm launch sets the same three variables. No frozen material changed. The pilot reruns in a fresh /private/tmp/ev/pilot3.

sessions.measurement: Two timed segments, excluding the user pause between them: the pilot3 batch invocation 11:22:51-11:35:34Z (verify, gate, both runs, cleanup; 763 s); evidence review and recording 11:38:08-11:39:23Z (75 s). Plus an allowance for issue resolution and handoff.

Scoring is not setup, so the scored shards add nothing here.
